content:
Priya: kicking off symphony-compact-v1 int8 bringup on staging. quick heads-up: initial recall@10 looks okay overall but short-query bucket is weird. posting summary.
EmbedBot: eval-run-9987 done: symphony-compact-v1 | quant=int8-per-tensor | dataset=prod-shortholdout | size=12k | status=complete :sparkles:
Priya: TL;DR
```
Model: symphony-compact-v1 (int8-per-tensor)
Dataset: prod-shortholdout (12k queries)
Recall@1: 0.602 (fp16 0.616, delta -0.014)
Recall@5: 0.821 (fp16 0.839, delta -0.018)
Recall@10: 0.901 (fp16 0.904, delta -0.003)
Precision@10: 0.74
Mean cosine (top1): 0.69 -> 0.62 (delta -0.07)
Cluster purity (agg labels): 0.57 -> 0.52
Notes: degradation concentrated on queries <=6 tokens, many false positives are high lexical overlap but semantically different.
```
Liam: can you paste eval command?
Priya: `./tools/eval_embeddings --model symphony-compact-v1 --quant int8 --dataset prod-shortholdout --normalize --batch 256 --nprobe 8 --seed 0`
Marta: interesting Recall@10 mostly intact but R@1/R@5 drop suggests ranking noise near top. maybe quantization noise increases local neighborhood disorder.
Noah: did you try disabling post-quant bias folding? that sometimes shifts vector mean.
Priya: not yet. running a quick variant with bias-folding disabled. queueing now.
EmbedBot: length-binned deltas (R@5):
```
len<=6: -0.064
6<len<=15: -0.021
len>15: -0.007
```
EmbedBot: flagged short-seq regression warning.
Liam: also check token embedding scale: multiply-by-pos or rotary fusion can change magnitude when quantized. compare pre-LN activations histogram vs fp16.
Priya: uploaded activations histogram: /mnt/artifacts/symphony/v1/int8/act-hist.png looks like first-layer projection std reduced ~12%.
Marta: try per-channel next, and also run asymmetric quantization. per-tensor is cheaper but may be losing head-level dynamics.
Priya: running per-channel now with 4 calibration batches sampled from prod. command: `./tools/quantize --model symphony-compact-v1 --mode per-channel --calib 1024`
Noah: also try client-side L2 renormalize as stopgap and measure R@1. should be fast to test.
Priya: tested renorm at retrieval: R@5 delta improved from -0.018 to -0.006 for short queries. posting numbers.
EmbedBot: added note: renorm reduced mean top1 cosine gap by 0.03.
InfraBot: FYI, perf numbers for int8-per-channel on p4d: latency median +3ms, p95 +8ms vs fp16.
Liam: good to know. Marta: if per-channel fixes rank order we should prefer per-channel for onboarding; add a guideline to docs.
Priya: creating ENG-ML ticket 2022: symphony-compact-int8-onboard. attaching plots and eval logs.
Marta: add a short-query gating rule: fail if R@5 delta <= -0.05 for len<=6.
Noah: also run cluster-consistency test: sample anchors, re-encode with quantized model twice and measure pairwise cosine drift.
Priya: doing that now.
EmbedBot: cluster-drift quickstats (n=500 anchors): mean intra-anchor cosine=0.96, std=0.02; quantized drift mean=0.12.
Liam: drift 0.12 is moderately high. suspect layernorm eps or rounding in final projection. try higher-precision for final MLP.
Priya: experimenting with hybrid quant: keep final proj fp16, rest int8. queued as run-9992.
Marta: thanks all. let's reconvene after the hybrid run. short-term mitigation: client renorm + increase nprobe to 12 for customers with short-query traffic.
Priya: noted, will add deploy note and update onboarding checklist. :white_check_mark:
EmbedBot: queued runs: per-channel calibrate, asymmetric scales, hybrid final-fp16. runcount=3.
